subject: Post-call: Ranking eval roadmap & action items
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Li <amanda@retailco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:15:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Ranking eval roadmap & action items

Hi Amanda —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good surface-level alignment on the reranking priorities and the success criteria (improve add-to-cart CTR by >6% and reduce irrelevant top-5 results). Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- What we saw in our light-weight pilot (on a small sample of your anonymized logs): NDCG@10 improved from 0.38 (current in-house model) to 0.41 with our candidate reranker; MRR moved from 0.24 to 0.27. These are early numbers — we need a larger validation set to be confident.
- Candidate models we recommend trying in the evaluation harness: redwood-rerank-3b-quant, llama-3-13b-rerank (baseline), and a tuned opt-13b-rerank variant.
- Artifacts attached/shared: pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (sample prompts + labels), initial_ndcg_mrr_pilot.pdf (short readout), and a short evaluation checklist. Also dropping the Drive folder with the benchmark harness and prompt sets here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-retailco-eval

Asks for your team:
1) Share the canonical evaluation set (or a 10–20k sample of your anonymized click/impression logs) and the schema for your product IDs & relevance labels.
2) Confirm whether we can run an A/B on a shadow mode for 2 weeks (no live weighting) — we’ll report back NDCG/MRR & top-k swaps.
3) Any constraints on PII/data residency we should be aware of (this affects whether we run in-hosted vs. private).

Internal note: Marissa — can you pick a target 2-week canary plan and a rollback threshold? Karthik — see pilot numbers above; we’ll need a standard eval harness run and gating thresholds.

Proposed timeline:
- 8/5: Redwood runs full eval on the 10k sample once received (turnaround 48h)
- 8/10–8/24: Shadow A/B canary, instrumentation + telemetry collection
- 8/26: Readout and recommendation for rollout (canary -> gradual rollout)

Happy to jump on a quick 30m tomorrow to go through the Drive artifacts if helpful.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (sample), initial_ndcg_mrr_pilot.pdf (readout)
From: Amanda Li <amanda@retailco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: RetailCo DS Team <ds@retailco.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Ranking eval roadmap & action items

Thanks Dylan — very helpful summary.

We’ll share a 15k anonymized sample from last quarter (schema attached in Drive). I’ve invited our DS engineer Jonah (jonah@retailco.com) to the Drive folder and given redwood the reader link. Two quick Qs: 

- Timeline: can you confirm the 48h turnaround includes running all three candidate models? If not, what’s the incremental time per model?
- Cost: can you ballpark the cost to run the 2-week shadow A/B (approx. impressions: 1.2M/day) so we can raise a procurement request?

Also re: PII — everything is anonymized, but we prefer hosted-in-our-region or private if possible.

I’ll upload the sample by EOD and set up a procurement PO request once we have a rough cost.

—Amanda Li
Head of Product, RetailCo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Li <amanda@retailco.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Ranking eval roadmap & action items

Great thread — a few concrete items from my side: 

- Canary plan (proposal): run shadow A/B for 14 days targeting 10% traffic slice (off-line scoring + metrics collection). If NDCG@10 delta < 0.015 or MRR delta < 0.02, abort and provide mitigation. If false-positive edge cases > 2% of top-5 swaps, pause and investigate.
- Metric set: NDCG@1/3/10, MRR, top-5 swap rate, CTR lift on impressions, latency P95, token cost per 1k requests.
- Deliverables to RetailCo: evaluation notebook (notebook + runbook), readout deck, and a recommended rollout plan with cost estimates.

Jonah/Amanda — to help procurement, we can provide a scoped SOW and an estimated run cost. Karthik — can you draft the SOW language for a 2-week pilot including safety/cost guardrails and the data handling commitments (no persistent storage, logs retained 30 days)?

Marissa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Li <amanda@retailco.com>, RetailCo DS Team <ds@retailco.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Ranking eval roadmap & action items

Amanda / Jonah — quick technical details: 

- Eval harness: we’ll run the three candidates sequentially on the 15k sample. Expected runtime: ~12 hours per model on a 4xA100 cluster for full-scoring; we can parallelize to 6–8 hours if we allocate more nodes.
- Instrumentation we’ll provide: per-query latencies, token counts, top-k score deltas, and a redwood-provided evaluation script that outputs NDCG@k and MRR with tie-breaking consistent with your current metric.
- Canary A/B approach: shadow scoring + collection of metrics server-side; no live reranking during the shadow (safe by default). For the live incremental rollout we recommend a 3-stage ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50%) with automated rollback triggers tied to CTR and error rate.
- Data requirements: csv with fields {query_id, user_id_hash, impression_positions, clicked_position (or -1), candidate_ids, candidate_features_json}. If you can strip user identifiers to hashed ids, that satisfies our PII policy.

I’ve started a draft SOW (SOW_draft_royalties_v1.docx) and put a timeline estimate in the Drive folder. For cost: ballpark for a 2-week pilot (including eval runs + 14-day shadow, 10% slice) is $8k–$12k depending on parallelization and whether you want private deployment. We can tighten numbers after we see the exact impressions/sample size.

Karthik
Sr. Applied ML Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Li <amanda@retailco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Ranking eval roadmap & action items

Amanda — thanks. Next steps summary for clarity: 
1) RetailCo uploads the 15k anonymized sample to the Drive folder (you mentioned EOD 8/4).
2) Redwood runs full eval on the three candidates (target completion 8/6 EOD).
3) If eval passes internal thresholds, schedule shadow A/B (8/10–8/24) — Marissa will own the canary and instrumentation.
4) Karthik to finalize SOW and cost estimate; Dylan will initiate procurement thread & DocuSign link once RetailCo confirms.

I’ll book a 30m readout for 8/6 11:00 PT to go over the evaluation results — invite to follow.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
